title: Deep Learning for Physicists: From Linear Regression to Reasoning Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.21295v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: These lecture notes are based on an introductory course on neural networks and deep learning that the author taught in the School of Mathematical Sciences at Queen Mary University of London in 2023/24 and 2024/25. The author, however, is a physicist, and it shows: wherever possible, ideas are explained with physical intuition rather than heavy formalism. Readers with a background in physics or mathematics who want a self-contained, introductory route into modern machine learning may therefore find these notes particularly friendly.   The notes start from maximum likelihood, least squares, linear regression and (stochastic) gradient descent. They then cover neural networks, backpropagation, the vanishing gradient problem, batch and layer normalization, overfitting and regularization, adversarial examples, and the kernel method. translated_title: 面向物理学家的深度学习：从线性回归到推理模型
translated_abstract: 这些讲义基于作者于2023/24和2024/25学年在伦敦玛丽女王大学数学科学学院教授的神经网络与深度学习入门课程。不过，作者是一位物理学家，这一点在讲义中显而易见：在可能的情况下，各种概念都通过物理直觉而非繁重的形式化方法来阐释。因此，具有物理学或数学背景、希望找到一条自足的入门路径进入现代机器学习的读者，可能会觉得这些讲义格外友好。讲义从最大似然、最小二乘、线性回归和（随机）梯度下降开始，随后涵盖神经网络、反向传播、梯度消失问题、批归一化与层归一化、过拟合与正则化、对抗样本以及核方法。后半部分转向自然语言处理：词嵌入、循环网络与LSTM、注意力机制……
tldr: 这是一套专为具有物理或数学背景的读者编写的深度学习入门讲义，以物理直觉为主线，内容涵盖从线性回归、神经网络基础到注意力机制等现代机器学习的核心主题。
en_tdlr: These lecture notes provide a self-contained, physics-intuition-driven introduction to deep learning for readers with physics or math backgrounds, spanning topics from linear regression and neural network fundamentals to attention mechanisms.
